title: Clarify empty editor guidance
prompt:
In lib/screens/songs/song_editor_screen.dart, replace the exact line:
                'No sections yet — type ChordPro below, or use Import / Add.',
with these lines:
                'No sections yet. Type lyrics below with chords in brackets, '
                'for example [Am]Hello. To add a section or import lyrics '
                'and chords, open Menu at the bottom.',
Edit only the listed file; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.
verify: rg -Fq 'for example [Am]Hello. To add a section or import lyrics ' lib/screens/songs/song_editor_screen.dart && rg -Fq 'and chords, open Menu at the bottom.' lib/screens/songs/song_editor_screen.dart && dart analyze lib/screens/songs/song_editor_screen.dart
